parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotating fan blade assembly made of ABS plastic, typically found in cooling fans.
parts.Functional_description: It rotates to generate airflow for cooling electronic components or ventilating spaces.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its central axis when powered by an electric motor.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the outer frame or housing of the fan, made of ABS plastic, providing structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the fan blades and motor in place, ensuring stability and proper airflow direction.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides a mounting surface for the rotating fan assembly.
